title: Senior Quality Control Analyst
description:
Senior Quality & Operations Specialist US Process Operations Location: Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu
 Work Model: Work From Office (WFO)
 Experience: 5+ Years
 Employment Type: Full-Time
 Shift: 9:00 am to 6:00 pm IST Position Overview We are looking for an experienced Senior Quality & Operations Specialist to support quality control, workflow management, and SLA performance for a US-based operations team. The role is responsible for reviewing high-volume operational documentation and transactions, ensuring deliverables meet defined quality standards and client-specific requirements, identifying errors and exceptions, coordinating corrections, and ensuring work is completed within established SLAs. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in quality control, process operations, documentation review, SLA management, exception handling, and high-volume service environments . Candidates with experience in US Mortgage, Insurance, Banking Operations, Healthcare Operations, BPO/KPO, E-commerce, Logistics, Supply Chain, Title Search, or other document-intensive US processes are encouraged to apply. Key Responsibilities Quality Control & Process Review Review operational documents, case records, transactions, and service deliverables for accuracy, completeness, and adherence to defined requirements. Evaluate completed work and determine whether it meets established quality standards or requires correction/rework. Identify missing information, inconsistencies, errors, and process exceptions. Perform quality audits and maintain consistent quality standards across assigned processes. Ensure work is completed accurately before and after key process milestones, as applicable. Apply client-specific procedures, quality guidelines, and SOPs consistently. SLA & Workflow Management Monitor daily workloads and ensure assigned work is completed within defined SLAs. Monitor pending, aging, and late cases and identify items at risk of SLA breach. Take appropriate action on cases that fall outside SLA or do not have a clear action plan. Coordinate with relevant operational teams to resolve exceptions and avoid delays. Escalate critical SLA risks and unresolved issues to the appropriate stakeholders. Communication & Coordination Communicate quality issues, rejected work, and required corrections clearly and professionally through email and chat. Provide specific and actionable feedback to operations teams. Coordinate with internal teams and US-based stakeholders to achieve timely resolution. Recommend practical alternatives when process issues may impact turnaround time or SLA. Maintain clear, professional, and accurate written communication. Reporting & Quality Management Prepare daily and periodic quality reports. Track quality findings, error categories, rework, exceptions, SLA breaches, and pending actions. Identify recurring quality issues and communicate trends to management. Support quality calibration and standardization activities. Maintain accurate records of audits, findings, corrective actions, and operational exceptions. Assist in identifying root causes of recurring errors. Process Improvement & Technology Identify opportunities to improve quality, reduce rework, improve turnaround time, and streamline workflows. Participate in process improvement and automation initiatives. Work with internal technology/product teams to identify opportunities for technology-enabled quality control. Contribute to SOPs, process documentation, checklists, quality guidelines, and workflow improvements. Support implementation of new processes, tools, and client-specific requirements. Required Qualifications 5+ years of experience in quality control, quality assurance, operations, process audit, transaction processing, or a similar high-volume service environment. Strong understanding of SLA management, exception handling, rework, and escalation processes . Ability to make independent and time-sensitive operational decisions. Excellent written English communication skills. Ability to write clear, concise, and professional emails. Strong attention to detail and ability to identify errors and inconsistencies. Strong organizational and multitasking skills. Ability to work independently in a high-volume, deadline-driven environment. Strong proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel, Word, and Outlook. Comfortable working with PDF/document management tools and web-based workflow applications. title: Sr Research Analyst - Pricing
description:
Senior Research Analyst Location - Vellore 
 Job Overview FactEntry is looking for a detail-oriented Senior Research Analyst to join the Bond Valuation Team . The role is primarily responsible for calculating, validating, and maintaining accurate daily prices and valuations across a broad range of fixed-income securities, including government bonds, corporate bonds, inflation-linked bonds, floating-rate notes, and other fixed-income instruments. The position involves validating prices and yields against external market sources, investigating pricing exceptions and significant market movements, and ensuring the accuracy and consistency of pricing across systems. The role also requires hands-on involvement in accrued interest, cash-flow calculations, inflation indexation, floating-rate calculations, and related pricing methodologies. The analyst will collaborate closely with Market Data, Reference Data, Operations, Technology, Product, and Client-facing teams to resolve pricing discrepancies, strengthen pricing controls, and improve existing processes. Key Responsibilities Calculate and validate daily prices for government, corporate, inflation-linked, floating-rate, and other fixed-income securities. Apply appropriate pricing methodologies, including YTM, spread, discount margin, clean/dirty price, and present value . Calculate accrued interest and settlement values. Perform cross-source validation to ensure pricing and market data accuracy. Maintain and validate government and benchmark yield curves. Investigate significant day-over-day price movements and pricing exceptions. Compare calculated prices and yields against external market sources. Maintain tolerance checks and exception reports. Set up and validate newly issued securities in the pricing system. Handle securities linked to CPI, RPI, and other inflation indices , including inflation index calculations and indexation factors. Perform floating-rate reset calculations and apply relevant reference-rate conventions. Validate coupon schedules, payment dates, maturity dates, and day-count conventions. Apply business-day calendars and appropriate holiday adjustments. Investigate and resolve pricing discrepancies reported by clients, Operations, or downstream systems. Respond to client queries relating to bond prices, yields, and valuation methodologies. Prepare and perform Client Coverage Reports . Maintain documentation relating to FRNs, Government Benchmark Yield Curves, and Inflation . Identify and implement automation opportunities to streamline pricing and validation processes. Qualifications Experience in Fixed Income Reference Data Operations and Corporate Actions . Minimum 1 + years of relevant experience as a Research Analyst. Working knowledge of SQL . Strong understanding of fixed-income instruments, bond attributes, terms and conditions, and lifecycle events. Strong analytical, research, and problem-solving skills. High attention to detail and a strong focus on data quality. Good communication and documentation skills. Proficiency in MS Excel and MS Office . Preferred Experience Experience in new-issuance bond processing. Experience handling fixed-income corporate action changes. Experience reviewing bond prospectuses and issuer documentation. Exposure to data quality validation and/or reference data teams. Knowledge of bond pricing, valuation methodologies, yield calculations, and market conventions. Key Skills Strong knowledge of Fixed Income instruments and bond markets . Good understanding of bond attributes, terms conditions, and lifecycle events. Strong analytical and research capabilities. High attention to detail. Strong problem-solving and data-quality orientation. Process-oriented approach with a focus on continuous improvement. Effective communication and documentation skills. Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams. Strong time-management skills. Willingness to continuously learn and adapt to evolving market and technology requirements.
